title: Fidji Simo is stepping down from her full-time role at OpenAI because her medical condition has worsened, and will become a part-time adviser (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Fidji Simo is stepping down from her full-time role at OpenAI because her medical condition has worsened, and will become a part-time adviser — The head of artificial general intelligence won't return from extended medical leave, a major leadership change as the AI giant prepares to go public
